capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

checklists.name: C# .NET Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for C# 10/12 standards, ASP.NET Core API design, EF Core, and Roslyn analyzers.

items.statement: Modern C# features (nullable reference types, records, pattern matching, async/await Task) are enabled and enforced.
ASP.NET Core dependency injection lifetimes (Transient, Scoped, Singleton) avoid captive dependencies.
Entity Framework Core queries use AsNoTracking() for read-only queries and avoid client-side evaluation warnings.
Roslyn analyzers and StyleCop rule sets enforce consistent naming conventions and code quality.
xUnit / NUnit test suites execute against in-memory or Testcontainers databases with high code coverage.

obligationDefinitions.title: NuGet package vulnerabilities must be tracked and remediated within SLA
obligationDefinitions.description: A vulnerability disclosed against a referenced NuGet package must be triaged and remediated (upgrade, patch, or documented waiver) within its severity's SLA, not left unaddressed once `dotnet list package --vulnerable` reports it.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Critical/High NuGet vulnerability is remediated or carries an approved waiver within its SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: NuGet vulnerability scan
requiredEvidence.description: Output of a NuGet vulnerability scan against referenced packages.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: `dotnet list package --vulnerable` / NuGet audit tool output.
